versions.changelog:
web-deploy v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides step-by-step guides for building and deploying web projects (websites, web apps, APIs) to production.
- Includes quickstart workflows for local preview: static, Next.js, FastAPI, and Vite projects.
- Documents deployment for Vercel (frontend), Railway (backend/APIs/databases), GitHub Pages (static), and Canvas (local server).
- Features a comprehensive pre-deploy checklist for production readiness.
- Explains rollback and custom domain configuration procedures for major platforms.
